Synthetic record: H2-SYN-1110
Date of service: 2026-10-23
Location: hospital outpatient endoscopy, fluoroscopy room (POS 22)
Endoscopist: Margarethe Oyelowo-Brandt, MD (fictional)
Procedures: ERCP with biliary stent exchange and duodenal biopsies.
Anesthesia: general anesthesia by the hospital anesthesia department (fictional), reported separately
Fluoroscopy: supervision and interpretation reported separately by the hospital radiology department (fictional)

Indication
Planned exchange of a plastic biliary stent for a benign common hepatic duct stricture after laparoscopic cholecystectomy. The stent, 10 French by 9 cm, was placed at ERCP on 2026-07-21, when a biliary sphincterotomy was also done. No symptoms; liver tests are normal.

Procedure
The duodenoscope was advanced to the major papilla. The existing stent was in position and draining. It was grasped with a snare and withdrawn through the working channel. The bile duct was then cannulated over a 0.035-inch guidewire without difficulty, and the wire was passed above the stricture into the right intrahepatic ducts. The cholangiogram showed a 1 cm stricture of the common hepatic duct, improved since July, with mild dilation above it and no filling defects. A new 10 French by 9 cm plastic stent was placed in the common bile duct across the stricture, with good drainage of bile and contrast.
No sphincterotomy was performed today, and no balloon sweep or stone extraction was done. Cold forceps biopsies of the second portion of the duodenum were taken. The pancreatic duct was neither entered nor opacified.

Impression
Benign common hepatic duct stricture, improving. Biliary stent exchanged: one plastic stent removed and one new plastic stent placed.

Plan
Clear liquids today, then a regular diet. Next stent exchange in about three months, probably placing two stents side by side if the stricture persists.

Electronically signed: Margarethe Oyelowo-Brandt, MD (fictional), 2026-10-24 07:52
